# coPetence Handbook

The landing page for the repository. It has no URL of its own — it *is* the
repository root, so `/handbook/index` must 404 rather than duplicating this page.

Internal links resolve at ingest: see the [introduction](01-introduction.md).
Everything below is a generated, ACL-filtered listing — no hand-maintained index
of sections, which is also why a restricted folder cannot be named here by
accident.
